description: This file defines the 'Skill' Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base DTO class, uses traits for ORM helpers, and provides methods to convert employee skill data into array form for reporting purposes. It includes properties and methods related to employee skills within the HR management context.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing an employee's skill, capable of normalizing skill data for reporting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Skill DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the employee's skills into a normalized array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of fields to the corresponding getter methods on the Employee entity for extracting skill-related data.
